blocks.text: Research ethics woh usool (principles) aur guidelines (hidayat) hain jin par researchers chalte hain ta ke un ka kaam imandar (honest), izzat wala (respectful) aur insaf wala (fair) ho. Yeh ethics research ki integrity (imandari) qaim rakhti hain aur study se jude har shakhs ke rights (haq) aur well-being (bhalai) ki hifazat karti hain, jaise participants (research mein hissa lene wale log), research community aur poori society (muashra).

Misal: farz karein aap survey kar rahe hain ke social media aap ke classmates ki parhai ki aadaton par kya asar dalta hai. Research ethics kehti hain ke koi bhi zaati maloomat lene se pehle un se ijazat (permission) lein, aur pakka karein ke un ke jawab raaz (confidential) rahein.

blocks.prompt: Classmates ke survey mein research ethics ke do farz bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Kitab ke mutabiq: (1) zaati maloomat jama karne se pehle un ki ijazat lein; (2) un ke jawab confidential (raaz) rakhein.

items: Research ethics: usool jo research ko honest, respectful aur fair rakhte hain.
Participants, research community aur society ke rights aur well-being ki hifazat.
